name: Machine Lateral Raise
steps: Sit with your chest against the pad and the arm pads resting on the outside of your upper arms, just above the elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders, leading with the elbows.
Pause, then lower slowly to the start.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
steps: Set a cable pulley at its lowest point and stand side-on to it, holding the handle in the far hand across your body.
With a slight bend in the elbow, raise your arm out to the side until it is level with your shoulder.
Lower slowly, keeping tension on the cable. Do all reps, then switch sides.

name: Landmine Press
steps: Set one end of a barbell in a landmine or a corner and hold the other end at shoulder height.
Stand with a staggered stance and brace your core.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight, then lower it back to your shoulder.

name: Iso-Lateral Chest Press (Machine)
steps: Sit with your back flat against the pad and the handles level with the middle of your chest.
Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight; each arm moves on its own.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.

name: Low to High Cable Fly
steps: Set both pulleys at their lowest point and stand between them, a handle in each hand.
With a slight bend in the elbows, bring your hands up and together in front of your upper chest.
Lower slowly back to the start, feeling the stretch in your chest.

name: Machine Hack Squat
steps: Stand on the platform with your back against the pad and shoulders under the pads, feet shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety handles and bend your knees, lowering until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
Drive through your feet to stand back up without locking your knees.

name: Pendulum Squat
steps: Step onto the platform with your back on the pad and shoulders under the pads.
Release the lock and squat down as deep as is comfortable, keeping your back on the pad.
Push through the whole foot to return to the top.

name: Belt Squat
steps: Fasten the belt around your hips and stand on the platform, feet a little wider than your shoulders.
Hold the handles for balance and squat down, keeping your chest up.
Stand back up by driving through your heels.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Stand a stride in front of a bench and rest the top of your back foot on it, a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower your back knee towards the floor until your front thigh is about parallel to it.
Push through the front foot to rise. Do all reps, then switch legs.

name: Machine Hip Thrust
steps: Sit in the machine with your upper back against the pad and the belt or pad across your hips.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, squeezing your glutes.
Lower under control.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and fasten it around one ankle. Face the machine and hold it for balance.
Keeping the leg nearly straight, kick it back and up, squeezing the glute.
Return slowly. Do all reps, then switch legs.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
steps: Kneel on a pad with your ankles held down by a partner or a fixed bar.
Keeping your body straight from knees to head, lean forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands, then push off lightly and pull yourself back up with your hamstrings.

name: Machine Seated Row
steps: Sit with your chest against the pad and take the handles with your arms straight.
Pull the handles towards you, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let the handles go forward slowly until your arms are straight again.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight.
Row the dumbbells up towards your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

name: Pendlay Row
steps: Bend over until your back is nearly level with the floor, the bar resting on the floor below your chest.
Pull the bar explosively to your lower chest, keeping your back flat.
Lower it back to the floor and let it settle before the next rep.

name: Seal Row
steps: Lie face down on a high flat bench with the bar on the floor beneath you.
Pull the bar up to the underside of the bench, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower it until your arms are straight.

name: Meadows Row
steps: Set one end of a barbell in a landmine and stand side-on to the other end, in a staggered stance.
Grip the end of the bar with one hand and row it up beside your hip.
Lower under control. Do all reps, then switch sides.

name: Assisted Pull-Up (Machine)
steps: Kneel or stand on the assistance pad and grip the handles above you.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the handles.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight. More weight on the stack means more help.

name: Assisted Dip (Machine)
steps: Kneel on the assistance pad and hold the dip handles with straight arms.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
Push back up to straight arms.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
steps: Set a pulley low, take the handle in one hand and step forward, facing away, so your arm is pulled back behind you.
Curl the handle forward and up, keeping your elbow behind your body.
Lower slowly to a full stretch. Do all reps, then switch arms.

name: Dead Hang
steps: Grip a pull-up bar with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang with straight arms and relaxed shoulders, feet off the floor.
Hold for as long as you can.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Bring your knees up towards your chest, curling your hips up.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Decline Sit-Up
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your feet hooked under the pads.
Curl up until your chest is close to your thighs.
Lower back down slowly.

name: Hollow Hold
steps: Lie on your back with your arms overhead.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your arms, shoulders and legs a little off it.
Hold the position, breathing steadily.

name: V-Up
steps: Lie flat on your back with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Lift your legs and upper body at the same time, reaching your hands towards your feet.
Lower back down under control.

name: Bird Dog
steps: Start on your hands and knees with a flat back.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your body.
Hold briefly, return, and switch sides.

name: Burpee
steps: From standing, squat down and put your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a push-up position and do a push-up.
Jump your feet back to your hands and jump up, reaching overhead.

name: Jumping Jack
steps: Stand with your feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start and repeat at a steady pace.

name: Wall Ball
steps: Stand facing a wall holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down, then drive up and throw the ball to a target on the wall.
Catch it and go straight into the next squat.

name: Swimming
steps: Swim lengths at a steady pace in any stroke.
Log the distance and the time.

name: Pigeon Pose
steps: From your hands and knees, bring one knee forward behind the same-side wrist and lay that shin across the mat.
Slide the other leg straight back and lower your hips.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.
